dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Knight. What brings you to the Cathedral today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lohen asked me to drop off a report...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Lohen? Submitting a report before the deadline? Truly a marvel of our time... Let me take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Hmm... The handwriting is quite neat, and the phrasing is very precise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong? Or is the report satisfactory?

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Nothing's wrong, aside from the fact that it's obvious Lohen didn't write a word of it. Ten to one, he outsourced this to Gunther or Ursula.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Still, at least he turned it in on time for once, and it looks like he actually bothered to check it himself... I won't say any more.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: I only hope Grand Master Varka and Lord Barbatos can find it in their hearts to excuse him, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Knowing them... They'll let it slide.
